text:
You need a clean, well-structured Google Sheets list of two separate prospect groups—IT/software resellers, integrators, and consultants selling into government, plus larger religious institutions—across Australia, New Zealand, Canada, and the United States.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I can help build this as a reliable data collection project with clear sheet structure and consistent formatting. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, data cleaning, data visualization, Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Google Sheets, and I’m comfortable working from detailed instructions and examples to make sure the records are useful and easy to review.

A couple of relevant examples from my past work:

- **Shopify customer segments (Juniper & Ash Home)** — I built customer segments from Shopify order exports by recency, frequency, and spend, then fed them to the email tool. One result was that the top segment made up **9% of customers and 41% of revenue**, and email revenue increased **19%**.
- **Weekly executive KPI pack (Alder Property Group)** — I built a scheduled KPI pack in Google Sheets and Looker Studio for occupancy, arrears, and maintenance that had previously been built by hand every Monday. That pack covered **22 KPIs** and saved **about 5 hours a week**.

For your project, I would organize the data carefully in Google Sheets, keep the two target groups separate, and make sure each entry is clean, consistent, and easy for you to use. I can also adapt quickly once you send the more detailed instructions and examples of the exact fields you want captured.

For **$200**, I would expect to deliver **about 200 records total**, split across the two categories as needed, and I’d estimate **3 to 5 days** to complete it once I have your detailed instructions. If you want, I can also structure the sheet so it’s easy to filter by country, organization type, and category.
